# Oliver Newth (n3wth.com)

> Oliver Newth is an AI and design leader in San Francisco. He builds AI products for Trust & Safety at Google (working with DeepMind on Gemini-powered products), previously led product at Covariant (acquired by Amazon), Meta (Instagram video calling, 750M daily users), and Microsoft (Azure Cognitive Services). He spoke at Google I/O 2025 on responsible AI in production. After dark he builds large-scale light installations for Burning Man and San Francisco memorials.

## Pages

- [Home](https://n3wth.com/): Who Oliver is — AI at Google, art in the desert.
- [Work](https://n3wth.com/work/): A decade of AI in production (Google, Covariant, Meta, Microsoft) and five products designed by hand, shipped by an autonomous agent team (r3, kit, hop.flights).
- [After dark](https://n3wth.com/art/): Light installations — THEM (Burning Man), Pink Triangle (Twin Peaks Pride memorial), Circle of Light (World AIDS Day memorial).
- [Thinking](https://n3wth.com/thinking/): Positions on production AI and agents as an org-design problem, with interactive AI-safety trade-off walkthroughs.
- [Contact](https://n3wth.com/contact/): oliver@newth.ai — AI safety, LED art, or coffee in San Francisco.
